name: CEPF Tropical Andes Biodiversity Hotspot grants (Peru, Colombia, Bolivia)

administered_by.name: Regional Implementation Team (PROFONANPE, ACEAA, Patrimonio Natural)

summary: CEPF small and large grants for civil society organisations conserving biodiversity in the Tropical Andes hotspot of Peru, Colombia and Bolivia, run through a regional implementation team. No call is open at the moment.

eligibility.rule: Legally independent of government, can receive private funds, cannot claim sovereign immunity

status.quote: No hay convocatorias abiertas de momento.

administered_by.quote: El RIT para Perú, Colombia y Bolivia incluye a PROFONANPE, ACEAA y Patrimonio Natural.

applicant_types.quote: información de interés para aquellas instituciones pertenecientes a la sociedad civil interesadas en postular a financiamiento de CEPF

geography.quote: Equipo Regional de Implementación (RIT) del Hotspot de Biodiversidad Andes Tropicales para Perú, Colombia y Bolivia

access.quote: Para poder postular es necesario revisar si actualmente se encuentran abiertas las convocatorias en la región

effort.quote: Large-grant applicants submit letters of inquiry online, through the online grants database ConservationGrants. Small-grant applicants submit letters of inquiry using an offline template that will be provided in the open call instructions.

These applicants will have a defined period of time (typically around two months, although this may vary among hotspots) to submit a complete project proposal through the online portal ConservationGrants.
If a project triggers one or more safeguard policies, the grantee will be asked to prepare the relevant safeguard document(s) and incorporate related measures into the project's design.

eligibility.quote: Son elegibles para poder acceder a financiamiento de CEPF las instituciones que: Tengan una persona jurídica independiente de cualquier agencia de gobierno o actor Tengan la autoridad para solicitar y recibir fondos privados No puedan hacer valer un reclamo de inmunidad soberana.

after_award.quote: Recipients of large grants must submit financial reports each quarter and progress reports every six months through ConservationGrants.
Large-grant recipients are required to attend a CEPF online orientation training within the first three months of their project's start date.
